answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because glacier only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, delta is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any nectar approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
